facts.fact: Africa Data Centres' LOS1 in Eko Atlantic City, Lagos, a carrier- and cloud-neutral colocation facility (cages, racks, cross connects), was launched in 2021 with 20.65 MW critical IT load and 10 halls.
The operator's data sheet describes LOS1 as a 'Rated-3' concurrently maintainable data centre; this is the operator's own statement, with no Uptime Institute certification or TIA-942 rating named.
